''); }; const saved = async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 100 && rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth?.pendingBoundary != null; i += 1) await pause(100); if (rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth?.pendingBoundary != null) throw new Error('the last boundary is not saved'); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let i = 0; i < 100 && ctx.isChatSaving; i += 1) await pause(100); await pause(1500); }; const reopen = async (storyId) => { const chatId = SillyTavern.getContext().chatId; await SillyTavern.getContext().reloadCurrentChat(); await until(() => rt.getSnapshot().storyId === storyId, 10000, 'the story to hydrate after the reopen'); if (SillyTavern.getContext().chatId !== chatId) throw new Error('the reopen moved the page'); rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); await pause(1500); }; const people = () => JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().game?.codex?.people ?? []); const places = () => JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().game?.codex?.places ?? []); const swipeable = async (text) => { const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const last = ctx.chat.length - 1; const reply = ctx.chat[last]; if (reply.is_user) throw new Error('the last message is not a reply'); reply.swipes = [reply.mes, text]; reply.swipe_id = 0; reply.swipe_info = [{}, {}]; await ctx.saveChat(); return last; }; globalThis.__c55 = { pause, until, values, line, saved, reopen, people, swipeable, OPEN: 'Promised you: get across the old bridge together (open)', KEPT: 'Promised you: get across the old bridge together (kept)', HOLD: 'You told the player you would get across the old bridge together', KEPT_LINE: 'You kept your word to the player: get across the old bridge together' }; if (people().includes('Promised')) throw new Error('a promise shows before it was made'); if (line('Arin').includes('You told the player you would get across the old bridge together')) throw new Error('the holder line exists before the promise'); return { people: people() };
